jetbrains.newrecipe.smith-printed-its-le: smith printed its levels in a form this plugin does not read. Update the plugin, or run smith recipe new in a terminal.
jetbrains.newrecipe.smith-knows-no-plugi: smith knows no plugin a recipe can fix. Update smith, or run smith recipe new in a terminal.
jetbrains.newrecipe.the-name-of-the-reci: The name of the recipe (for example team):
jetbrains.newrecipe.the-first-version-of: The first version of the recipe (empty takes 0.1.0):
jetbrains.newrecipe.the-recipe-this-one-: The recipe this one extends (empty for none):
jetbrains.newrecipe.tick-the-plugins-the: Tick the plugins the recipe fixes at the {level} level. Tick none to leave it to the users of the recipe.
jetbrains.newrecipe.leave-it-to-the-user: Leave it to the users of the recipe
jetbrains.newrecipe.the-recipe-fixes-no-: The recipe fixes no plugin at the {level} level.
jetbrains.newrecipe.pick-the-plugin-the-: Pick the plugin the recipe fixes at the {level} level.
jetbrains.newrecipe.smith-runs-this-comm: smith runs this command and writes {recipeLevelsMapper} in the workspace folder. Nothing is committed.
jetbrains.newrecipe.use-lowercase-words-: Use lowercase words joined by dashes, for example "team" or "team-node". The name is the name of the recipe's releases.
